description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Switch Draw Mode III (Fire, Ice)], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Junk Shop Mode], [Junk Shop Mode Critical] and [Draw Revolver Mode] to the user

description.name: Renzokuken Frostfire
description.text: 5/6/7/8 single attacks (0.90 each) if the user has Weapon Mod level 0/1/2/3

description.name: Custom Revolver
description.text: Three single attacks (0.80 each), grants Weapon Mod +1 to the user

description.name: Switch Draw Mode III (Fire, Ice)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice ability

description.name: Junk Shop Mode
description.text: Cast speed x2.00, keeps track of the number of uses of Custom Revolver (0~3), grants [Junk Shop Critical] after using Custom Revolver, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]

description.name: Draw Revolver Mode
description.text: Grants [Soul Break Gauge +250] and [Instant Cast 1] to the user after using a Spellblade ability, removed after triggering, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
